title: Pagination and consistent exports
brief: Choose a continuation contract for a changing list and a snapshot contract for an export.
outcomes: Build a keyset cursor that preserves ties
Explain omissions, duplicates and retention costs under concurrent changes
entry: Ordered results and transaction snapshot basics.

heading.title: An ordered continuation
heading.brief: Compare offset and keyset walks through tied placed_at values, using order_id as a tie breaker and matching index order.

heading.title: Changes between pages
heading.brief: Insert, delete and reorder rows around the cursor; distinguish expected movement from a promise to export a fixed set.

heading.title: A fixed export
heading.brief: Follow one snapshot through batches; compare a long transaction with materialised membership and an engine-supported historical read.

heading.title: Slow readers
heading.brief: Explain cursor lifetime, connection ownership, cancellation and version retention; bound the export rather than assuming streaming removes database work.
